dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Strongly concave trailing edge with a deep falcate curvature that narrows significantly towards the apex and widens towards the posterior insertion point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded apex with a moderate pixel radius; lacks acute or squared-off termination.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Convex leading margin with an angular steepness of approximately 50 degrees relative to the horizontal dorsal ridge axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: The ratio of the maximum horizontal base width to the maximum vertical height is approximately 1.7:1.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple irregular nicks and small notches are visible along the distal half of the trailing edge; superficial linear striations and varied skin texture are present on the lateral fin surface.
other_distinctive_markers: A distinct dark grey to black pigmentation patch is visible on the upper third of the fin, contrasting with the lighter grey of the lower section.
